events.description: Implementation of the 'Pathway to Profit' initiative, formally commenced in April 2007, which altered growth strategy by slowing new store openings to 7%-10% per year (with 161 stores opened in 2007) versus the historical rate of 14%, focusing instead on expanding the outside sales force in existing stores.
events.source_quote: During April 2007 we disclosed our intention to alter the growth drivers of our business... We intend to fund this sales force expansion with the occupancy savings generated by opening stores at the rate of 7% to 10% per year (we opened approximately 8.1% new stores in 2007 or 161 stores) versus the historical rate of approximately 14%.

events.description: On October 18, 2007, a wage-and-hour class action lawsuit was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California against Fastenal Company alleging misclassification of Assistant General Managers as exempt. The parties have agreed to submit the claims to non-binding mediation on or before August 15, 2008.
events.source_quote: On October 18, 2007, a complaint was filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California against Fastenal Company on behalf of two former employees claiming to represent all employees employed in the store position of Assistant General Manager in the United States... The suit alleges Fastenal misclassified its Assistant General Managers as exempt for purposes of the overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and California and Pennsylvania state statutes... The parties are currently conducting discovery and have agreed to submit the claims to non-binding mediation on or before August 15, 2008.

events.description: Fastenal has a $40 million line of credit expiring on June 1, 2008, which had $0 outstanding as of March 31, 2008.
events.source_quote: We have a line of credit totaling $40 million which expires on June 1, 2008... On March 31, 2008 there was $0 outstanding on the line.

events.description: Subsequent to the quarter end, on April 15, 2008, the Compensation Committee approved a grant of options to purchase approximately 300,000 shares of common stock at a strike price of $54 per share.
events.source_quote: On April 15, 2008, the Compensation Committee of our Board of Directors approved the grant, effective at the close of business that day, of options to purchase approximately 300 thousand shares of our common stock at a strike price of $54 per share.

events.description: Fastenal provided a $2.613 million ($2,613 thousand) loss on disposal reserve at March 31, 2008 for operating leases of pickup trucks containing residual value guarantees with an aggregate residual value of approximately $12.623 million ($12,623 thousand) at lease expiration.
events.source_quote: Certain operating leases for vehicles contain residual value guarantee provisions, which could become due at the expiration of the operating lease agreement if the fair value of the leased vehicles is less than the guaranteed residual value. The aggregate residual value at lease expiration, of the leases that contain residual value guarantees, is approximately $12,623 at March 31, 2008... except for a $2,613 loss on disposal reserve provided at March 31, 2008.
